proposed_widenings.name: suppress_slot_cost
proposed_widenings.justification: Spell Mastery's core mechanic is that two chosen spells can be cast at their lowest level without expending a spell slot. No v4 atom covers suppression of a resource cost for a specific spell. The closest existing atoms are 'spell_slot' (the resource) and 'suppress' (procedure for suppressing effects), but neither expresses 'for this specific spell, the slot resource is not consumed at base level'. A new atom — or a new variant of the resource/effect vocabulary — is required to represent slot-cost suppression for a named spell.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast them at their lowest level without expending a spell slot

proposed_widenings.name: grant_at_will_cast (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect currently has only GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect. Spell Mastery grants a passive ability to cast a specific chosen spell at will (no slot). This requires a new ClassFeatureEffect variant that references a spell selection and modifies its casting cost to zero at base level. Without this variant, no honest encoding of this feature is possible in the activation family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast them at their lowest level without expending a spell slot

proposed_widenings.name: spell_selection_from_book (surface shape for class feature spell reference)
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature requires choosing specific spells from the wizard's spellbook at feature acquisition time, with constraints (level 1 and level 2, casting time = action). There is no surface type for 'a spell chosen from the spellbook at acquisition time' in ClassFeatureMechanics. The existing 'stored_spell' attachment is part of SpellMechanics only (e.g., Contingency). A class-feature-level spell-selector surface type is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell in your spellbook that have a casting time of an action

proposed_widenings.name: replace_stored_spell_on_rest (or analogous atom for swapping a mastered spell reference on long rest)
proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary mechanic — swapping one mastered spell for another eligible spell on a Long Rest — requires expressing a rest-gated replacement of a stored spell reference. The closest existing atoms are 'replace_on_recast' and 'rest_window', but neither covers 'on long rest, optionally replace one element of a stored spell selection with a new one from the book'. This is a secondary gap; the primary one (suppress_slot_cost) is the blocker.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of those spells with an eligible spell of the same level from the book.

notes: The unit kind (class_feature) and family (activation with free cost) could structurally fit, but the ClassFeatureEffect union has no member for 'cast a specific spell without a slot'. This is not a structural gap — the activation family is the right shell — but the effect vocabulary is missing the at-will-cast / suppress-slot-cost concept. v4 taxonomy has no corresponding atom either. The long-rest spell-swap mechanic is a secondary widening; the primary blocker is the missing effect atom. No .dhall or .json authored.
